scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and positive finite contact certificate supplied; symbolic and finite numerical checks are not independent proof and do not constitute external validation.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional, origin-centered, perpendicular filled disks of positive radii; no statement for oblique or displaced disks, three summands, or arbitrary full-rank ellipsoids. Parameterized enclosing-ellipsoid bounds and determinant minimization within those families are established prior art. Historical priority is not independently certified. Finite symbolic/numerical checks supplement a self-contained unrestricted optimality proof.
title: Exact John and Löwner ellipsoids of the Minkowski sum of two perpendicular disks
